articles.title: Patch Tuesday, May 2026 Edition
articles.summary: CISA contractor accidentally published AWS GovCloud keys and internal secrets on GitHub because apparently the agency protecting our infrastructure can't protect their own credentials. Peak government cybersecurity right here, folks.

articles.title: MFA Prompt Bombing: Why Your Second Factor Isn't Saving You
articles.summary: Microsoft patches SharePoint RCE vulnerability CVE-2026-45659 with CVSS 8.8 rating. Another day, another Microsoft product that can be remotely owned by anyone with basic exploitation skills.

articles.title: Google blocked the first known AI-powered attack on 2FA accounts; here is how hackers tried to break in, know how to stay safe
articles.summary: Zero-click WhatsApp takeover hits iOS 16 users without any linked devices or warnings. Your iPhone just became someone else's messaging platform and you wouldn't even know it happened.

articles.title: (喝抗紊ф┨ / note, 4/26) Canada Bill C- ...
articles.summary: Claude AI helps researcher discover 10-year-old RCE in Linux PDF viewers (XReader/Evince/Atril). When an AI finds bugs that humans missed for a decade, you know we're living in interesting times.

articles.title: Microsoft Took a Step Toward Human Rights Accountability. Google and Amazon (and Others) Should Pay Attention!
articles.summary: EFF celebrates end-to-end encryption victories while governments continue their eternal quest to break everything that keeps our conversations private. The crypto wars never ended, they just got more bureaucratic.

articles.title: Remembering Tim Wilson, Whose Legacy Lives on at Dark Reading
articles.summary: EFF releases guide to fight digital surveillance abuses across the Americas where accountability is a myth and legal frameworks are weaker than my coffee. Time to actually do something about systematic human rights violations.

articles.title: [THN Webinar] New AI DDoS Attacks Are Smarter. Learn How to Fight Back
articles.summary: Megalodon campaign poisons 5,500+ GitHub repositories in massive supply chain attack. The ocean's apex predator has nothing on modern malware distribution networks.

articles.title: Who is TeamPCP, the rising hacker group targeting open-source software and AI tools?
articles.summary: TeamPCP supply chain campaign hits three package ecosystems and even breached GitHub's internal codebase while trojanizing Microsoft's own Python SDK. These folks are either very good or everyone else is very bad.

articles.title: The sandworm malware strikes: How a hacker group stole 4,000 GitHub repositories and exposed the rot at the core of modern software security
articles.summary: Hacker sells 340 million OnlyFans user records compiled from old breaches and public profiles. Someone turned data archaeology into a profitable side hustle targeting adult content consumers.

articles.title: AIPAC, AI, Crypto, and Gambling Are Hiding Their Big Election Spends
articles.summary: Judge sanctions private prison giant CoreCivic for destroying video evidence in ICE detainee death case. Finally, some accountability for corporations that profit from human misery and evidence destruction.
